// provider-agnostic: Provider/model/thinking intentionally NOT committed here. This repo is provider-agnostic: live machines pick a provider via `pi auth login` and store the choice in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json (defaultProvider, defaultModel, defaultThinkingLevel, enabledModels) plus model-thinking.json / workflows/model-tiers.json. install.sh preserves all of those on reinstall; repo values are first-run fallbacks only.
